title: FRED Yield Curve Pro
description: Pro-tier variant of fred_yield_curve. Keeps all base columns and adds a Nelson-Siegel-style level/slope/curvature decomposition computed from the nine tenor points: curve_level (long-end anchor, 20y+30y average), curve_slope (10y minus 2y, sign-preserved), curve_curvature (2×5y minus 2y minus 10y - positive = humped, negative = valley), plus inversion_depth_bp (the maximum magnitude of any negative spread in basis points). Gives Claude a compact three-number characterization of the curve shape. trust_level: unrestricted - uses numpy (which is actually allowlisted in the sandbox, but this variant lives under the unrestricted tier for consistency with the _pro pattern and to demonstrate the convention).
code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations'
API_KEY = CREDENTIALS.get('FRED_API_KEY', '')
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

SERIES = [
    ('DGS1MO', '1_month'),
    ('DGS3MO', '3_month'),
    ('DGS6MO', '6_month'),
    ('DGS1', '1_year'),
    ('DGS2', '2_year'),
    ('DGS5', '5_year'),
    ('DGS10', '10_year'),
    ('DGS20', '20_year'),
    ('DGS30', '30_year'),
]

yields = {}
for series_id, label in SERIES:
    resp = requests.get(
        BASE,
        params={
            'series_id': series_id,
            'api_key': API_KEY,
            'file_type': 'json',
            'sort_order': 'desc',
            'limit': 1,
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    obs = resp.json().get('observations', [])
    if obs and obs[0].get('value', '.') != '.':
        yields[label] = float(obs[0]['value'])
    else:
        yields[label] = None

y10 = yields.get('10_year')
y2 = yields.get('2_year')
y3m = yields.get('3_month')
y30 = yields.get('30_year')
y5 = yields.get('5_year')
y20 = yields.get('20_year')

spread_10y_2y = round(y10 - y2, 4) if y10 is not None and y2 is not None else None
spread_10y_3m = round(y10 - y3m, 4) if y10 is not None and y3m is not None else None
spread_30y_10y = round(y30 - y10, 4) if y30 is not None and y10 is not None else None

is_inverted_10y2y = spread_10y_2y < 0 if spread_10y_2y is not None else False
is_inverted_10y3m = spread_10y_3m < 0 if spread_10y_3m is not None else False

if is_inverted_10y2y and is_inverted_10y3m:
    signal = 'STRONG_RECESSION_WARNING'
elif is_inverted_10y2y or is_inverted_10y3m:
    signal = 'RECESSION_WATCH'
else:
    signal = 'NORMAL'

# --- Pro additions: level / slope / curvature decomposition ---
long_end = [v for v in (y20, y30) if v is not None]
curve_level = round(float(np.mean(long_end)), 4) if long_end else None
curve_slope = spread_10y_2y  # same definition
# Nelson-Siegel curvature proxy: 2*medium - short - long
if y5 is not None and y2 is not None and y10 is not None:
    curve_curvature = round(2.0 * y5 - y2 - y10, 4)
else:
    curve_curvature = None

# Inversion depth: the most negative spread in basis points (100 bp = 1 full yield-percent)
spreads = [s for s in (spread_10y_2y, spread_10y_3m, spread_30y_10y) if s is not None]
negatives = [s for s in spreads if s < 0]
inversion_depth_bp = round(float(min(negatives)) * 100.0, 2) if negatives else 0.0

# Curve shape classifier
if curve_level is None or curve_slope is None:
    curve_shape = 'UNKNOWN'
elif curve_slope < -0.1:
    curve_shape = 'INVERTED'
elif curve_curvature is not None and curve_curvature > 0.3:
    curve_shape = 'HUMPED'
elif curve_slope < 0.2:
    curve_shape = 'FLAT'
else:
    curve_shape = 'STEEP' if curve_slope > 1.0 else 'NORMAL'

rows = [{
    'yield_1m': yields.get('1_month'),
    'yield_3m': yields.get('3_month'),
    'yield_6m': yields.get('6_month'),
    'yield_1y': yields.get('1_year'),
    'yield_2y': yields.get('2_year'),
    'yield_5y': yields.get('5_year'),
    'yield_10y': yields.get('10_year'),
    'yield_20y': yields.get('20_year'),
    'yield_30y': yields.get('30_year'),
    'spread_10y_2y': spread_10y_2y,
    'spread_10y_3m': spread_10y_3m,
    'spread_30y_10y': spread_30y_10y,
    'is_inverted_10y2y': is_inverted_10y2y,
    'is_inverted_10y3m': is_inverted_10y3m,
    'curve_signal': signal,
    # Pro additions:
    'curve_level': curve_level,
    'curve_slope': curve_slope,
    'curve_curvature': curve_curvature,
    'inversion_depth_bp': inversion_depth_bp,
    'curve_shape': curve_shape,
    '_epoch': now_epoch,
}]

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
